bio: A slug with a golden fur crest swept over its head and an orange-tan hide. It leaves a shiny trail and says the trail is the best trail anyone has ever seen.
It has grown so heavy it no longer moves for anyone. It puts its name on every rock it sits on, then charges the other slugs to sit there.
A vast, gold-flecked slug that fills a whole hall. Its tiny arms wave at a crowd only it can see. It calls everything tremendous, mostly itself.
note: Counts the crowd, then adds a few.
Plays golf with its tail and wins every time.
